response.query: What objective inclusion/exclusion rules, stop/go criteria, and minimal success thresholds should we use to select pilot repos (Pilot A/B) and decide go/no-go at each milestone?
response.answer: Objective inclusion/exclusion rules prioritize pilot repos based on production quantity completion and strategic alignment; stop/go criteria depend on milestones met and deliverables achieved; minimal success thresholds require at least 70% completion of key objectives by each pilot.
